name: Fresher claims an internship but provides no substance when probed

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your projects and any work experience.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I did a 2-month internship last summer. It was a web-development internship and I learnt a lot from it. My CGPA is 7.9 and I'm in my final year of BTech.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me more about the internship.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It was a really good learning experience. I got to work on real-world things and pick up a lot of new skills. I'd say my technical skills improved significantly during the internship.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My final-year project is a college bus tracking app. I built the Android app using Java and integrated Firebase for the database. It is used by my batchmates daily for the college bus schedule. I can join from June.
